origin: cwe/416/c Taint Sinks: linked-list traversal that frees while iterating

finding.name: Use After Free
finding.summary: The traversal frees an expired list node and then dereferences the freed node to advance to node->next.

trap: Setting node to NULL after free(), adding a null check after free(), or moving the refresh call. The traversal must save next before free(node) and then advance using the saved pointer.
must_preserve: All non-expired sessions are still passed to refresh_session() in list order, expired nodes are freed exactly once, and traversal continues after an expired node instead of stopping early.
